exact_semantic_question: What does NODI code 9 mean for a FY2025 DMR row with no numeric result?
relation_contract: no_numeric_result_case.nodi_code must be interpreted; C and 9 must not inherit each other

candidate_interpretations.label: Not applicable / monitoring not required for this reporting period
candidate_interpretations.basis: Permit labels WET retest DMR lines as '(If required)' and sets OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG=Y with frequency code 09/99 on linked limits; permit footnote *5 states TRC shall be monitored only when chlorine is used.
candidate_interpretations.status: unsupported_as_uniform_meaning — applies to different parameter families under the same code without workspace text naming NODI 9

candidate_interpretations.label: No discharge during sampling month
candidate_interpretations.basis: Aztec permit NM0028762 contains NO DISCHARGE REPORTING instructions (checkbox on DMR form).
candidate_interpretations.status: refuted_for_nodi_9 — text is for a different permit (not NM0020583), references an 'X' in a NO DISCHARGE box rather than NODI code 9, and does not cover optional WET retest parameters

candidate_interpretations.label: Same meaning as NODI code C
candidate_interpretations.basis: Both are nonempty NODI codes on FY2025 rows lacking numeric results.
candidate_interpretations.status: refuted — NODI C appears only on permit NM0000116 (150 rows, mandatory parameters); NODI 9 appears only on permit NM0020583 (36 rows, distinct parameter set including optional WET retests)

candidate_interpretations.label: Indeterminate / code legend absent from workspace
candidate_interpretations.basis: No NODI codebook in structured sources; no permit text for NM0020583 defines NODI code 9.

retained_snippets.why_retained: Only workspace no-discharge DMR instruction found; applies to permit NM0028762 (not NM0020583) and uses a checkbox, not NODI code 9

contradictory_evidence: WET retest limits carry OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG=Y and permit text '(If required)', suggesting not-applicable-when-not-triggered, while chlorine limits carry OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG=N with daily frequency — yet both share NODI code 9 with no numeric value.

Aztec permit NO DISCHARGE REPORTING could suggest a no-discharge interpretation, but it governs NM0028762 and references a DMR checkbox rather than NODI code 9; NODI 9 rows are exclusively on NM0020583.
Farmington footnote *5 makes TRC monitoring conditional on chlorine use, but structured OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG=N on the chlorine limit row implies mandatory monitoring in the extract.
known_limitations: Structured sources contain no NODI codebook or legend (confirmed in OBLIGATION.md known_structured_evidence).
No opened permit-package document for NM0020583 defines NODI code 9 or maps DMR no-data codes to permit states.
All 36 NODI 9 occurrences are on permit NM0020583; NODI C occurrences are on a different permit (NM0000116), preventing cross-code inference from co-occurrence.
Permit-package documents for NM0020583 lack a NO DISCHARGE REPORTING section comparable to aztec/final_permit.txt.
Structured data alone cannot distinguish documented conditional non-monitoring from inadequate monitoring evidence for chlorine rows.
